annotations.title: Create independent evidence for a completed payment

description: Use after a supported payment has occurred to independently observe its exact network and transaction reference and create or return a signed OCD receipt. Never sends, signs or authorizes payment. Policy remains UNKNOWN: no agent identity, wallet ownership, provider identity or service-delivery claim. Pending requests must be retried with the same reference, not another payment.

network.description: Supported observation network, such as eip155:8453 or solana:mainnet.

transaction_reference.description: Exact EVM transaction hash or Solana signature; no credentials.

name: create_payment_receipt
title: Create independent evidence for a completed payment
